page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top: "De Episcopatu" at left and "Q.VIII." at right. Page number "90" at top left. Catchword "jam" at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: rebus de quibus præceptum speciale divinum nullum est,nimirum de riti-bus in se indifferentibus, seu iis, quæ ad externum Ecclesiæ ordinem per-tinent Cl. Rivetum in decal: p. 267. 168. Alsted. in Supplem. Chamierii, Amesium Medull. lib. 2. c. 17. Ubi observandum 1. ne ferat leges circa ceremonias, quę cum periculo Ido-lolatriæ sint conjunctæ,item ne mul-titudine rituum talium obruat Eccle-siam Christianam, ut in Papatu fa-ctum. Deinde tenendum; Magistra-tum leges Ecclesiasticas ferre posse, non tantùm ut ministrum Dei, sed etiam respectu hominum cum impe-rio proprio ac potestate coactiuâ temporali; nec pendere eum in illis ferendis à potestate aliquâ humanâ superiore; consequenter etiam non opus habere confirmatione aliena (quamvis consilium prudentiû, pio-rum & peritorum Doctorum Ec-clesiæ recte adhibeat) & denique ob-ligari conscientias illis legibus et-iam

page.notes: Running head is "De Episcopatu"; "Q.VIII." at the right is a chapter marker in the head, not part of the title, and is not transcribed as running head. Page number printed in old-style figures as "90". Catchword "jam" is set at the lower right, below the last line. Italic readings for "decal" and "in Supplem." are uncertain; the scan is heavy there. The word "1." after "observandum" is printed as a numeral. "tinent" follows the line-end hyphen of "per-". No printing errors were confirmed.
